content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
My camera app draws face boxes when I think someone’s name. It’s like it recognizes the thought.
Face boxes are triggered by visual patterns. When the boxes appeared, what was in view—photos, posters, mirrors, or TV screens?
A poster with people and sometimes a mannequin in a shop window.
Those contain face-like features. Does the box appear if you frame a blank wall or a simple object under the same lighting?
On a blank wall it doesn’t box anything.
That difference suggests visual triggers. A few screenshots with and without face-like content, taken back-to-back, would make the contrast clear.
If the boxes cluster on images with faces or face-like shapes, the behavior matches the detector’s design.
